name: Microsoft Designer
summary: Microsoft's AI graphic design app for social posts, invitations, cards and other graphics.
description: Microsoft Designer is a graphic design app that creates social media posts, invitations, digital postcards and other graphics. Users start from an idea written in plain language, and the app generates images and layouts that can then be edited. The main page did not render readable content to automated checks during this review, so details are taken from the site's metadata, and no pricing information could be confirmed.
